description: cert_not_after() calls load_cert_chain() and then takes the first cert with into_iter().next(). This implicitly assumes the first cert is the leaf (server cert). Standard PEM ordering puts the leaf first, but if an operator accidentally puts an intermediate CA first, cert_not_after returns the intermediate's expiry, which may differ from the leaf's. The function's doc says 'first certificate in a PEM certificate chain file'; this assumption should be either enforced or documented more prominently.
title: tls: cert_not_after parses only first cert in chain; chain ordering not validated
